label: kizuna_botan_a_02
text: Hurry up and hide! And keep quiet, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_03
text: Phew... That was close.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_select_01
text: Whatcha doing?

label: kizuna_botan_a_select_02
text: Something up?

label: kizuna_botan_a_04
text: Um... Yeah, you know, I’m just... Errr...\c\n*sigh*\nGuess I might as well come clean.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_05
text: Take a look over there.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_06
text: Do you get it now?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_select_03
text: ...Not really?

label: kizuna_botan_a_select_04
text: A little context, please?

label: kizuna_botan_a_07
text: Ah. Sorry. Your jump scare earlier completely\nfrazzled me. My brain’s still trying to reboot.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_08
text: All right, here’s the sitch. Team Star’ve started\ncoming to school again...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_09
text: But I don’t know if they’re gonna fit in OK, and\nit’s been playing on my mind, you know?\r\nSo I’m checking on them from over here...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_01
text: Hmph... Guess we’re still not exactly gettin’ a\nwarm welcome here, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_01
text: Well, duh.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_02
text: Sure, the teachers finally figured out we’re not a\nbunch of delinquents...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_03
text: But it’s not like we can press some magic button\nto make everyone else accept us.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_02
text: True story. We gotta fix this, my man. Time for a\nchange of tack![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_10
text: Huh? A change of tack...?\c\nWhat, are they gonna start wearing normal school\nuniforms so they stop scaring off the other kids?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_11
text: Oh, Momo... Ortie... They’re both really trying\ntheir best to fit in here at school...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_04
text: A “change of tack,” huh? What exactly are\nyou suggesting?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_03
text: Buh? I mean, uhhh...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_04
text: How ’bout we say a big, friendly howdy to\neveryone here? Like, just yell it. Loud as we can.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_05
text: WHAT?! That’s stupid! Go on and embarrass\nyourself if you want to, but count me out![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_12
text: Errr. Yeah, that idea seems a bit...off.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_05
text: Hold up—lemme explain.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_06
text: You know Ryme, right? She does this at her\nconcerts, no joke.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_07
text:
If the crowd ain’t hyped at the start of the show,
she’ll shout the loudest greetin’ you ever heard
into the mike. Like “S’UP Y’ALL” or whatever!\c
Lifts the mood like nobody’s business.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_06
text: Yeah, that makes sense. ’Cause those are\nCONCERTS. This is SCHOOL. It’s different.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_08
text: OK, smart guy. So we’re optin’ for the cold\nshoulder treatment forever, then, are we?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_07
text: N-no... That’d totally suck.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_09
text: It would, wouldn’t it? So yeah. Our only option is\nto yell at everyone so they know we’re nice.\r\nHere, I’m gonna go for it...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_10
text: HEEEY!!! MORNIN’, Y’AAAAAALL!!!\nHOW WE ALL FEELIN’ TODAAAY??!![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_08
text: Oh nooo! Giacomo! What are you DOING?!\nThis is SO embarrassing![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_11
text: EVERYONE HAVIN’ A GOOD TIIIIIIME??!!\nC’mon, Ortega—you gotta do it, too![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_09
text: Hold on a sec! You...you’re just practicing for\nyour DJ sets, aren’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_12
text: THANKS FOR COMIN’ TONIGHT!!!\nQuick! Say it![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_10
text: TH-THANKS FOR COMING TONIGHT!!![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_11
text: ...HEY! What do you mean, “thanks for coming”?!\nWe’re not hosting anything![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_13
text: What. On. Earth.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_mob_01
text: Are those guys from Team Star? What the heck\nare they yelling for?

label: kizuna_botan_a_mob_02
text: Is this some kind of skit? Heh...they’re pretty\nfunny!

label: kizuna_botan_a_mob_03
text: I guess they’re not as scary as I thought...?

label: kizuna_botan_a_15
text: P-people are actually warming up to them?!\nWhy? That makes zero sense![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_16
text: Haaah... Momo and Ortie really are operating\non a different level. I’m kind of amazed.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_17
text: Seems all my worrying was for nothing, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_a_18
text: Now that that’s all settled, I guess I should get\ngoing. Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
